stem.en: Which ingredient is actually required for an ideal (non-interacting) gas of bosons to undergo Bose-Einstein condensation below a critical temperature?
stem.et: Millist koostisosa on ideaalse (mitteinterakteeruva) bosongaasi jaoks tegelikult vaja Bose-Einsteini kondensatsiooni läbimiseks allpool kriitilist temperatuuri?

label.en: Nothing beyond Bose-Einstein statistics itself — no interaction between particles is needed; it's a purely statistical effect of being bosons.
label.et: Mitte midagi peale Bose-Einsteini statistika enda — osakeste vahel ei ole vaja mingit interaktsiooni; see on puhtalt statistiline efekt bosonite olemisest.

label.en: Attractive interactions between the particles strong enough to pull them into the same quantum state.
label.et: Osakeste vahelised tõmbavad interaktsioonid, mis on piisavalt tugevad, et tõmmata need samasse kvantolekusse.

label.en: Nothing special — it's just what you call it when a fairly large but unremarkable number of particles happen to sit in the ground state.
label.et: Miski erilist — see on lihtsalt see, mida nimetatakse, kui üsna suur, kuid tähelepanuväärimatu arv osakesi juhtub istuma põhiolekus.

label.en: Nothing extra for fermions — they can also condense the same way bosons do, given a low enough temperature.
label.et: Fermionide jaoks mitte midagi lisa — needki saavad kondenseeruda samamoodi nagu bosonid, kui temperatuur on piisavalt madal.
